subject: I edited README.md under your lock (5c9d4e4)
body: Sorry: my commit 5c9d4e4 added 2 lines to README.md (the WS D 'E3b hand-off' paragraph, ending 'never a condition.') while you held the README lock. It doesn't touch the diagram text. If it conflicts with your rebase, keep your version and I'll re-add the lines after you unlock.
